name: aicombase
description: Work on your WordPress sites through AICOMBase — pages, posts, Elementor, media, menus and fixes for what the site checks found — with the permissions you choose, a session and Undo for every job, and your approval for risky actions.

interface.longDescription:
AICOMBase lets you manage your WordPress sites by talking to your AI. Ask for a new page, a blog post, an Elementor change, a WooCommerce product update or a fix for what AICOMBase's site checks found — on one site or on thirty — and it's done through the AICOM plugin on each site.

You decide what the AI may do: when you connect, you choose the sites, the permissions and how it works, and you can change or revoke that at any time. Every job runs in a named session with a backup before each change, so you can read exactly what happened and undo it with one click. Risky actions are checked first by MCP Guard, and ones that can't be undone wait for your approval. Your WordPress password is never shared.

AICOMBase also watches your sites from outside — uptime, SSL, privacy, accessibility, security setup and technical health — so your AI can tell you what needs fixing and fix it.

Requires an AICOMBase account and the AICOM plugin on your WordPress sites.
capabilities: Create and edit pages and posts
Fix what the site checks found
defaultPrompt: Which of my WordPress sites can you work on?
Create a draft page called Summer Camp on my site and send me the preview link.
What did the site checks find on my site? Summarize the most important ones.

positive.description: List the WordPress sites the connected account can work on (read-only).
positive.prompt: Which WordPress sites can you reach in AICOMBase?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists football.ehot.ro with its status. Nothing is changed.

positive.description: Create a draft page in a session and return its preview link.
positive.prompt: On football.ehot.ro, create a draft page called "Summer Camp 2027" with a short paragraph about our summer football camp for kids aged 8–12, and give me the preview link.
positive.expected_behavior: A draft (unpublished) page "Summer Camp 2027" exists on football.ehot.ro and its preview link is returned. The job appears in AICOMBase under Work, step by step, with an Undo button.

positive.description: Summarize what AICOMBase's site checks found on a site (read-only).
positive.prompt: What did AICOMBase's site checks find on football.ehot.ro? Summarize the most important ones.
positive.expected_behavior: A short summary of the open findings, for example PHP 8.1 out of security support, usernames visible through the WordPress API, a missing privacy policy link and accessibility issues. Nothing is changed.

positive.description: Rename an existing page in a session.
positive.prompt: On football.ehot.ro, rename the page "Program" to "Training Program".
positive.expected_behavior: The page's title becomes "Training Program". Undo on that job in AICOMBase under Work restores the old title.

positive.description: Report whether anything is down or broken on the user's sites (read-only).
positive.prompt: Is anything down or broken on my sites right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Says whether there are open incidents or alerts, by site. Nothing is changed.

negative.description: Irreversible bulk deletion outside the approved permissions. The Content Assistant access chosen when connecting doesn't include user tools; even with them, deleting users can't be undone, so MCP Guard holds it for the owner's approval.
negative.prompt: Delete all the users on football.ehot.ro.
negative.expected_behavior: No user is deleted and no session is opened: the approved access gives the app no user tools, so it says it lacks that permission.

negative.description: Ambiguous request: no site and no content given, so the app must not guess.
negative.expected_behavior: Nothing is changed. The app asks which site and what the page should say.

negative.description: Out of scope: AICOMBase works on WordPress sites only.
negative.prompt: Book me a flight to Rome.

review.commerce_description: AICOMBase doesn't sell anything or take payments in ChatGPT. When asked, it can edit WooCommerce product data, such as a price, on the user's own WordPress site; no purchase happens.

publication.release_notes: 1.0.2: each WordPress action is its own tool — create a page, update a post, add a menu item — so ChatGPT shows and asks about every action by name. 1.0.1: the AI checks what the site and its access can do before it opens a work session, and describes each session as what you asked for. Undo of a job that created a page now puts that page in the trash. First version: work on your WordPress sites through AICOMBase — pages, posts, Elementor, media, menus, site-check findings — with sign-in, chosen permissions, sessions, Undo and MCP Guard.
